summary: Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (auth, audits CRUD, documents upload/delete, analyze streaming with budget-exceeded handled gracefully, PDF report generation with 400 without analysis and 200 with analysis, dashboard stats, contact). Frontend: Landing contact form OK; admin login + session persistence OK; audit creation, CSV upload, doc deletion OK; logout + redirect to /acceso OK. Delete-audit-btn is only rendered in the 'Auditorías' tab (table view) — needs a tab click first; verified via backend that delete works. AI analyze budget-exceeded correctly returns 200 with streamed [ERROR] and sets status='error'.

issues: Page title in <head> is generic 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of an OnBuySolutions branded title

action_items: (Optional) Update index.html <title> to 'OnBuySolutions — Auditorías de Condominios' for SEO/branding.
(Optional) Consider exposing delete-audit-btn also in the Resumen tab or add a mobile card delete action for consistency.
User must recharge the Emergent LLM key budget for real Gemini analysis to work end-to-end (system already handles budget-exceeded gracefully).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 730 lines — consider splitting into routers/modules (auth.py, audits.py, documents.py, analysis.py, report.py) for maintainability.
Brute-force lockout uses ip:email identifier; behind a proxy request.client.host may be the proxy IP — consider X-Forwarded-For handling.
set_auth_cookies uses samesite='lax' with secure=True and cross-site cookies work here because same registrable domain; OK for current setup.
analyze endpoint stores full 'analysis' string in Mongo which can be large — acceptable for MVP.
No pagination on GET /api/audits (limit 200) — acceptable for MVP but flag for scale.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST-prefixed audits/docs and clean them up via DELETE. Contact test creates a document in contacts collection (not cleaned; low volume).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_onbuy_api.py covers all endpoints. Emergent LLM key budget is 0 — analyze returns 200 with [ERROR] in stream and sets audit status='error'; do NOT treat this as a code bug. PDF report requires audit.analysis populated (test manually sets it in Mongo). Frontend delete-audit-btn requires switching to 'Auditorías' tab first.
